executive_verdict.current_maturity_level: Asymmetric Execution Engine (L0-L8 Strong, Upstream Genesis Absent)
executive_verdict.summary: M31A possesses an exceptionally high-integrity downstream autonomous execution engine (AutonomyController, SchedulerEngine, AgentRunner, WorktreeManager, EvidenceCompletionGate, ConfigurationControlPlane, and Ratatui TUI cockpit). However, M31A operates exclusively in reactionary, single-task execution mode. The entire Upstream Genesis and Multi-Stage Workflow Orchestration layer is completely absent.

fatal_seams.name: No Project Genesis or Discovery Mechanism
fatal_seams.description: M31A has no concept of an exploratory interview, ambiguity scoring, or charter definition (PROJECT.md). High-level ideas immediately create single tasks.

fatal_seams.name: Hardcoded Monolithic Planning Prompts
fatal_seams.description: PlanServiceImpl::generate_initial_plan uses a hardcoded prompt commanding: 'CRITICAL: Output EXACTLY ONE task in the tasks array: TASK-01. Do NOT produce multiple tasks for a bug fix or single-component repair.' Falls back to static 3-task stub without a model.

fatal_seams.name: Hardcoded Single-Task Context Compilation
fatal_seams.description: ProductionContextCompiler compiles a prompt hardcoded for single-component parser bug fixes ('Workflow Guidance: Step 1: inspect tests... Step 2: run_tests... Step 3: write_file... Step 4: run_tests... Step 5: complete'). It ignores AgentRole completely.

fatal_seams.name: No Multi-Agent Research Orchestrator
fatal_seams.description: AgentRole::Researcher exists, but there is zero logic to evaluate research necessity, partition research into dimensions (stack, features, architecture, pitfalls, security), run them concurrently, or synthesize outputs.

fatal_seams.name: No Architecture or Roadmap Generation
fatal_seams.description: AgentRole::Architect is an unused enum. M31A has no models, prompts, or generators for ARCHITECTURE.md, DECISIONS.md (ADRs), or ROADMAP.md.

fatal_seams.name: No Workflow Definition Abstraction
fatal_seams.description: There is no concept of WorkflowDefinition, WorkflowRun, or WorkflowStep in the codebase. The engine only executes flat Missions.

fatal_seams.name: No Dependency Invalidation Engine
fatal_seams.description: Mutating an upstream requirement cannot invalidate downstream architecture, roadmaps, or tasks. Stale artifacts remain authoritative.

acceptance_criteria: Single-Crate Integrity: 100% of code inside single m31a crate; zero Cargo workspace conversions
Zero Faked Success: No mock returns or stubbed strings in workflow steps; all artifacts produced by real reasoning or deterministic tools
Deterministic Authority: LLM never updates workflow state; state transitions owned strictly by Rust runtime
Data-Driven Manifests: Greenfield and brownfield workflows defined in declarative TOML manifests
No Hardcoded Prompts in Rust: Prompts loaded from versioned PromptContract assets with parameter schemas
Parallel Research Concurrency: Independent research dimensions execute concurrently on Tokio thread pool
Artifact-Based Handoffs: Zero chat history passed between steps; downstream steps consume only validated artifacts on disk
Cascading Invalidation: Requirement changes deterministically mark downstream architecture and roadmaps Superseded
Durable Crash Survival: SIGKILL during workflow execution resumes at in-flight step without data loss
Golden Workflow Validation: Complete end-to-end greenfield execution passes from idea to verified build

mandatory_questions_answers.1_does_m31a_currently_have_real_project_: NO. M31A has an environment onboarding wizard and a single-task execution loop, but zero workflow for turning an abstract project idea into an engineered project.
mandatory_questions_answers.2_can_m31a_produce_validated_requirement: NO. Requirements domain models exist, but PlanServiceImpl uses hardcoded single-task planning prompts.
mandatory_questions_answers.3_can_m31a_perform_multi_agent_research: NO. Researcher role exists, but there is no orchestrator to partition dimensions, spawn parallel researchers, or collect outputs.
mandatory_questions_answers.4_can_it_synthesize_research: NO. There is no synthesizer agent or tradeoff resolution engine.
mandatory_questions_answers.5_can_it_generate_architecture_from_requ: NO. Architect role is an unused enum variant. Cannot generate ARCHITECTURE.md or ADRs.
mandatory_questions_answers.6_can_it_derive_roadmap_from_architectur: NO. Only plans immediate single-task missions; no phased roadmapping capability.
mandatory_questions_answers.7_can_artifacts_feed_existing_execution_: YES architecturally, NO currently wired. Once ROADMAP.md is generated, each phase maps directly to an M31A Mission executed by AutonomyController and SchedulerEngine.
mandatory_questions_answers.8_can_downstream_artifacts_be_invalidate: NO. Currently no artifact dependency tracking or invalidation engine exists.
mandatory_questions_answers.9_can_workflow_steps_run_in_parallel: YES at subsystem level (SchedulerEngine wave execution), NO at workflow level (no workflow engine to schedule them).
mandatory_questions_answers.10_can_workflow_state_survive_restart: YES for missions/tasks, NO for workflows (workflow_runs table and state machine missing).
mandatory_questions_answers.11_can_humans_approve_major_decisions: YES. EffectivePolicy and ApprovalModal already support interactive approvals; workflow engine will directly hook into this.
mandatory_questions_answers.12_can_prompts_become_versioned_workflow: YES. By introducing PromptContract and minijinja templates stored in TOML files.
mandatory_questions_answers.13_can_workflow_definitions_become_data_: YES. By adopting TOML workflow manifests parsed by WorkflowEngine.
